Environment (recommended, not required):
  NOT FOUND codegraph — used for semantic code analysis in /akili-constitution, /akili-audit, and worker briefs.
           Without it, commands fall back to Glob/Grep with a lower-confidence scan.
           Install: npm install -g @colbymchenry/codegraph, then run codegraph init -i in your project.
  NOT FOUND playwright-cli — used for token-lean browser automation for E2E Testers and browser verification (Skill Map row; alternative to loading the Playwright MCP).
           Without it, E2E/browser work loads the Playwright MCP schemas into every session instead.
           Install: npm install -g @playwright/cli, then run playwright-cli install --skills FROM YOUR HOME DIRECTORY (it writes to ./.claude/skills of the cwd).
  NOT FOUND codex — used for the OpenAI Codex CLI itself — required to load and run the Codex-hosted skills this installer writes.
           Without it, Codex-hosted commands/skills cannot be loaded; if the binary is present but still reports NOT FOUND, it may be a broken vendor install (spawn ENOENT) — reinstalling usually fixes it, and on Windows only a codex.cmd shim is probed, not a standalone codex.exe.
           Install: npm install -g @openai/codex.
